Runner-up: $275 strike for ultra-conservative positioning ($271.95 eff. basis right at 52W low), tightest spread (3.2%), highest OI (1,531).

### Covered Call — Entry Conditions: 🔴 SKIP (2/4)

- ❌ RSI 36.6 — oversold, not overbought
- ❌ Weekly RSI 26.9 — deeply oversold

**Verdict: SKIP.** RSI 36.6/26.9 on daily/weekly — in pullback. Selling calls caps recovery and locks in losses. Wait for RSI > 60.

### LEAPS Monitor — Score: 4/6 🟢 LEAPS ALERT
- ❌ Daily RSI 36.6 — close but above 35 threshold
- ✅ Weekly RSI 26.9 curling up from 19.6 — stabilizing

Consider waiting for IV normalization.
